title: AccountRegistryEntry
description: Logical execution account. Stores metadata and secret references; NEVER credentials.

account_id.description: Stable logical account id (e.g. tb-master-01). Unique across the registry.

broker_provider.description: Provider family. TRADELOCKER is UNKNOWN/future only in R0.

environment.description: Broker-reported environment. REAL requires explicit human authorization.

server.description: Broker server name for identity matching (e.g. OxSecurities-Demo).

login_identifier_reference.description: Reference to the login/account id (masked in metadata; value held in secret store).

margin_mode.description: Margin mode reported by broker where available.

hedging_or_netting.description: Position-accounting model. UNKNOWN must fail closed for shared accounts.

portfolio_group_id.description: Set when the account is a PORTFOLIO_MASTER or participates in a shared group.

strategy_allowlist.description: Strategy ids permitted to bind to this account. Empty = none (fail closed).

execution_enabled.description: Operator intent flag; independent from identity match. Both must be true to trade.

copier_role.description: Observability only. FOLLOWER replication is outside execution authority.

terminal_or_session_binding.description: Terminal path / session identity for fail-closed account-terminal matching (MT5).

secret_reference.description: Reference only: env-var key, OS keyring id, or encrypted secret-store id.

identity_matched.description: Derived: broker-reported identity matches the bound profile.

metadata_version.description: Bump on schema/semantic changes for hashable config lineage.
